before.title: Aurelia 1978 launch campaign and Logix Computer Academy — execution
before.description: Communicate the launch, qualify demonstrations and coordinate follow-up described by the source campaign.

outcomes.description: Attractively edited broadcast feature with a clear business-user narrative
Short station-ready news packages and demonstration excerpts
Clean footage, separate narration/audio where practical, accurate captions and a factual product/Academy press sheet
Full edited presentations for stations wanting longer technical coverage

steps.description: Newspaper and business-press teasers introduce Aurelia and the personal-assistant promise; coming this spring, followed by June 5 launch date; brochure and invitation requests.
Cinematic TV commercial and explanatory print advertisements; prioritise markets with demonstration, support and Academy coverage.
Press previews, dealer/staff preparation, launch invitations, television-station outreach and complete venue rehearsal.
NCC premiere in Anaheim, five-city Academy announcement, package and availability presentation, registration and ordering.
Technical sessions, repeated hands-on demonstrations, professional recording of every Logix NCC presentation and Academy registration.

Edit and freely distribute television packages; run Academy courses and dealer demonstrations; advertise practical business uses, real package prices, local dates and documented customer experience as it becomes available.

Target 10–15 pilot businesses and several accounting practices; reconcile results against existing records. Validate representative data volumes, disk/RAM budgets, posting, corrections, backup/restore and supported payroll jurisdictions before launch claims.

Qualify all advertised launch modules and a modest summary export to Abacus. Train instructors and dealers, publish requirements and support boundaries, and prepare a joint press preview. Measured capacity and final jurisdiction coverage remain acceptance gates, not invented results.

Begin BPI dealer qualification and accountant demonstration access, permission-based case studies and defined paid setup assistance. Each initial Academy centre has access to a BPI specialist; recruit or train ahead of demand.

Run year-end preparation workshops and module-upgrade demonstrations. Specify payroll update coverage and maintenance terms. Customer data remains under customer control; referrals do not imply an accountant endorsement without consent.

Expand demonstrations and qualified support using verified customer results. Promote module-to-suite upgrade credit. BPI Model II support is a separate future negotiation; the existing Tandy agreement covers Abacus only.
broadcast program / scope: Every Logix presentation at NCC 1978, including the premiere, both technical sessions, partner appearances, questions and any additional Logix sessions.

broadcast program / production: Professional multi-camera crew with clean presenter audio, audience/reaction coverage and close-ups of the computer, screen, connections and printouts. Retain full-session recordings and production masters.

broadcast program / distribution: Offer and supply the material free of charge to any television station wishing to broadcast it; Logix covers normal duplication and dispatch. Supply station-compatible broadcast copies on request.
broadcast program / broadcast fee usd: 0

broadcast program / editorial policy: Station participation, scheduling and editorial selection are voluntary; no guaranteed airtime, compulsory advertising purchase or claimed editorial endorsement. Identify the material as supplied by Logix.

broadcast program / rights: Arrange presenter, partner, music and production rights covering free television redistribution before recording. Michael Douglas commercial footage may be included only if separately cleared for this use.

broadcast program / fidelity: Do not accelerate startup or recalculation, conceal failures through misleading cuts, or present pre-recorded footage as a live result. Identify edited excerpts and show only qualified claims.

broadcast program / timing: Record throughout June 5–8; begin station outreach before NCC and distribute edited packages after the conference as edits and broadcast clearances are completed. Exact delivery dates and runtime remain production decisions.

broadcast program / engineering: Qualify a custom Aurelia digital-video-to-projection/recording path; rehearse readability, lighting and sound in the hired room. Use a backup demonstration system and clearly identified recorded fallback.
Post-NCC 1978 recording, editing and television distribution

before.title: NCC 1979 open architecture and migration campaign — execution
before.description: Recruit independent computer, software and peripheral manufacturers to the published compatibility programmes, and help existing customers carry their applications and documents across supported systems.

steps.description: Begin confidential briefings and engineering-kit evaluations. Prioritise North Star and Vector Graphic as prospects; approach Cromemco, Altos, Intertec and Heath selectively. Invitations are not signed agreements or qualified products.

Alongside the existing DRI portable-extension release, publish separate CP/M application, FlexiBUS peripheral and optional Logix display compatibility profiles, reference-driver and test access, non-exclusive implementation principles and support-roadmap requirements. Exact fees and support duration remain to be settled.

Invite computer, software and peripheral suppliers to test named configurations and document failures before public demonstrations. Supplier attendance and passing results must be verified; no announcement of an unsigned OEM.

Present a 50-minute cross-vendor campaign before questions. Demonstrate applications/documents, then independent BPI, FlexiBUS, Apple native drivers and optional video. BPI management speaks with partners. State that the next generation breaks native Z80 binary compatibility; C source/API portability reduces migration work and a planned optional Z80 compatibility coprocessor supports qualified legacy software. Reveal neither processor word size nor architecture before NCC 1980. See ncc_1979_campaign.json.

Run dealer demonstrations, joint trade-press activity and developer clinics. Teach documented APIs, file interchange, C portability boundaries and device-class drivers. Publish a directory distinguishing shipping, qualified and prototype configurations.

Promote the separately recorded Tandy customer release and only individually qualified SMC or peripheral products. Update directory evidence; do not imply all licensed chips, every peripheral class or new independent OEM systems are shipping.

Target Tandy shipping, one additional named OEM selling a supported CP/M-extension/FlexiBUS option, another OEM in qualification, dealer/integrator configurations and third-party devices in several categories. These are adoption targets, not recorded achievements or contracted orders.

Publish verified customer examples, compatibility results and partner configurations. Target three to five non-Logix manufacturers with supported configurations by NCC 1980, counting Tandy once and excluding duplicate dealer builds. Do not disclose the new processor architecture early.
existing anchors / Tandy: Existing agreement: CP/M, native display adapter, FlexiBUS option and Abacus; no video requirement or BPI port.
existing anchors / Apple: Existing native expansion cooperation and peripheral/display demonstrations; no Z80 or CP/M execution provided.
